g.text: Points show observed differences (left minus right). Bars show 95% source-paired bootstrap intervals.
Filled markers indicate test acceptances within the pairwise tolerance. BoT-SORT uses motion only.
BoostTrack-v1 uses host states. The BoT-SORT adapter uses a first-order covariance approximation.
